name: solidworks
description: Parametric 3D CAD modeling, interactive in-chat studio, FEA simulation, and drawing generation in Dassault Systèmes SolidWorks.

interface.longDescription: Control Dassault Systèmes SolidWorks live in chat. Create parametric parts, adjust dimensions with interactive sliders, generate 2D engineering drawings, and run FEA stress simulations.
defaultPrompt: Create a mounting bracket with 4 M6 counterbore holes in SolidWorks.
Open interactive studio with sliders to tweak dimensions.
Run a static FEA simulation with 500N downward load.
